tools.name: Facebook Graph API
tools.description: Publishing posts, photos, and link shares to the EEVL Facebook Page. Reading engagement metrics.

publish_post.description: Publish a text or link post to the EEVL Facebook Page.

publish_photo.description: Publish a photo post with caption.

get_post_insights.description: Retrieve engagement metrics for a published post.

schedule_post.description: Schedule a post for future publication using the scheduled_publish_time parameter.

tools.name: Instagram Graph API
tools.description: Publishing feed posts, carousels, stories, and reels to the EEVL Instagram account. Reading engagement metrics.

create_media_container.description: Create a media container for a single image or carousel item.

publish_media.description: Publish a prepared media container to the feed.

create_carousel.description: Create a carousel container from multiple media containers.

get_media_insights.description: Retrieve engagement metrics for a published post.

tools.name: Twitter/X API v2
tools.description: Publishing tweets, threads, and media to the EEVL Twitter/X account. Reading engagement metrics.

create_tweet.description: Publish a tweet with optional media attachment.

upload_media.description: Upload an image for attachment to a tweet.

get_tweet_metrics.description: Retrieve engagement metrics for a published tweet using tweet.fields=public_metrics.

tools.name: LinkedIn API
tools.description: Publishing posts, articles, and document (carousel) posts to the EEVL LinkedIn Company Page. Reading engagement metrics.

create_post.description: Create and publish a post with text, image, or document attachment.

upload_image.description: Register and upload an image asset for post attachment.

get_post_stats.description: Retrieve engagement statistics for company page posts.

tools.name: Google My Business API
tools.description: Publishing local posts to the EEVL Google My Business listing. Reading post views and action metrics.

create_local_post.description: Create a 'What's New' or 'Offer' post on the EEVL GMB listing.

get_local_post_metrics.description: Retrieve views, clicks, and action metrics for a GMB post.

tools.name: Email Distribution Service
tools.description: Newsletter distribution to the EEVL subscriber list with A/B testing, open/click tracking, and subscriber management.

send_campaign.description: Create and send an email campaign to a subscriber list.

create_ab_test.description: Set up an A/B test with two subject line variants and automatic winner selection.

get_campaign_stats.description: Retrieve open rate, click-through rate, bounce rate, and unsubscribe rate.

get_subscriber_count.description: Get the current subscriber count for the EEVL newsletter list.

tools.name: SocialBot Sub-Agent
tools.description: The SocialBot sub-agent orchestrates the entire distribution workflow — sequencing posts, managing timing, handling retries, and coordinating engagement monitoring.

tools.name: Analytics Aggregator
tools.description: Aggregates engagement metrics from all platforms into a unified dashboard and generates distribution performance reports.
